ModMetaData.author: Rick
ModMetaData.name: ESCP - Dark Brotherhood
ModMetaData.description: The Elder Scrolls Collaboration Project Presents: The Dark Brotherhood. A murderer's covenant bound by the Tenets of Sithis and the will of the Night Mother. The Brotherhood does not advertise. Clients find them through the Black Sacrament, a ritual performed in silence with bones and flesh and a specific kind of desperation. The Brotherhood takes the contract, sends an assassin, and the target dies. They do not guarantee it will be clean, and they do not offer refunds. The only thing they will not do is kill a brother. That rule has exceptions too, when the Listener decides it does.
